newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures weaker in bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures weaker in bearish sentiment.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended weaker on Wednesday as selling in nearby months pressured the market amid bearish sentiment, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 3.6 yen per kilogram lower. Benchmark April was flat at 140.9 yen.

The market opened lower across the board, despite of the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar, but short-covering ahead of the close helped prices rebound slightly from the day's lows. "Bumper rubber stocks still cast a shadow on the market," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
